{{Quote|Those in our service pride ourselves on loyalty and discipline.|Republic Judicial Terrinald Screed|<ref name="HNN54">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|regional/1352_4.html|Vigilante Taskforce Departs to Engage Separatists}}</ref>}}
The '''Judicial Department''' (sometimes called the '''Judiciary''' or the '''Judiciary Department''') was the primary [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Under the command of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], it became a department of the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] during the last decades of the Republic. Though the [[Judicial/Legends|Judicials]] of the department, in general, served as law enforcement and later also as military forces, the department had specific agencies to provide police services. This included the [[Republic Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Republic Office of Criminal Investigations]] (ROCI), the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] (officially under the ROCI), the [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]], and the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]]. The ROCI was in charge of coordinating Republic criminal investigations and managed the Sector Rangers, one of the earliest law enforcement agencies in Republic service. The Republic Security Force was composed of uniformed [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] called [[Republic Peace Officer]]s. It provided basic law enforcement services to Republic [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] including emergency response, traffic control, apprehending criminals and conducting raids. Though officially a part of the Judicial Department, the Senate Guard mostly acted independently.

After the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] the department was drastically reorganized, and its responsibilities were expanded. Notably, the Judicial Department was placed in charge of supervising the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Also, the remaining forces of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] were reorganized as the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]], the only form of a standing [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] the Republic would have for the next thousand years. With the coming of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Judicial Forces' navy and ground units were merged into the re-established [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], respectively. The Jedi Order similarly became a part of the military command structure. With these changes, the Judicial Department focused solely on law enforcement duties until it was dissolved with the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
===Duties and departments===
[[File:Lieutenant_Williams.png|thumb|left|175px|Judicial Forces Lieutenant Antidar Williams]]
The Judicial Department was the primary [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="compswe" /> Headquartered in the [[Judicial Arcology/Legends|Judicial Arcology]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="HHNwebsite" /> the Judicial Department was responsible for policing the Republic's space and investigating criminal activities. To accomplish this, the department managed several agencies with specific law enforcement duties.<ref name="compswe" /> This included the [[Republic Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Republic Office of Criminal Investigations]] (ROCI), the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] (officially under the ROCI),<ref name="holo14414">{{InsiderCite|67|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:4:14}}</ref> the [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]],<ref name="RepGuard">{{CSWECite|III|95|Republic Guard}}</ref> and the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]].<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> The ROCI was charged with coordinating investigations by law enforcement agencies of criminal activities.<ref name="ROCI">{{CSWECite|III|95|Republic Office of Criminal Investigations}}</ref> They also supervised the Sector Rangers.<ref name="holo14414" /> The Rangers were one of the earliest law enforcement agencies in Republic service and though officers were assigned on a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] level, the Rangers had Republic wide jurisdiction and were usually sent to investigate organized crime.<ref name="rangers">{{CSWECite|III|133|Sector Rangers}}</ref> The Republic Security Force, also called the Republic Guard, was composed of uniformed [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] called [[Republic Peace Officer]]s. Republic Security provided basic law enforcement services to Republic [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that requested them including responding to emergency calls, controlling traffic, apprehending criminals and, when needed, conducting raids.<ref name="RepGuard" /> The Senate Guard, though an official branch of the Judicial Department, mostly worked independently and ultimately answered to the [[Senate Guard committee]].<ref name="GAW" />

===Organizational structure===
{{Quote|The Judicial Department has requested that I meet with them later today, so they can brief me on the latest developments.|Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum|<ref name="CoD" />}}
The Judicial Department was a part of the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] and led by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]. Members of the department including [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] and other officials were referred to as [[Judicial/Legends|Judicials]]. The [[Director of Investigation/Legends|Director of Investigation]] was in overall command of investigations conducted by the Judicial Department.<ref name="compswe" /> The [[Director of Personnel]] was in charge of recruiting new Judicial members.<ref name="HNN53155">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 55|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #55]]</ref> In regards to press relations, the [[Director of Information|Information Director]] was responsible for notifying the public of Judicial activities and giving statements.<ref name="HNN53148">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 48|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #48]]</ref> For the prosecution of cases, the department had several General Attorneys and their assistants.<ref name="HNN53156">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 56|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #56]]</ref> [[Sector Coordinator]]s were in charge of Judicial operations within their assigned [[Sector/Legends|sector]].

For those that sought service within the Judicial Department, most graduated from the [[Judicial Academy/Legends|Judicial Academy]] though others also entered the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] and the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]].<ref name="HHN52academy">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|news/13418_2.html|Carida Backs Military Creation Act}}</ref>

==History==
It existed as far back as the [[Indecta Era]], when it developed [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] technology.

After the Ruusan Reformation, the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was reorganized as the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] and placed under the command of the Judicial Department. Along with the [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Republic Outland Regions Security Force]]<ref name="compswe" /> and the [[Republic Special Task Force/Legends|Republic Special Task Force]]<ref name="Panaka">''{{DB|character|captainpanaka|Panaka, Captain}}''</ref> they patrolled Republic space and assisted the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] when extra military force was required. The Ruusan Reformation also placed the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] under the supervision of the Judicial department.<ref name="compswe" />

Following the disastrous [[Eriadu Trade Summit]], the Senate passed restrictions on the Judicial Department, limiting the cases in which the Chancellor could use it without first gaining explicit approval from the Senate. These restrictions were presumably lifted sometime during the administration/reign of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

[[File:Judicials-raid.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Judicials raid an illegal pit race.]]
During the [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]] incident in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the Judicial Department requested a meeting with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] and later informed him of the hostilities that emerged between the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]]. They were later deployed to deal with the crisis before it escalated. In [[22 BBY/Legends|21.5 BBY]], the Judicial Department was involved in an ongoing investigation of the [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] government in order to determine their treatment of the native [[Korun/Legends|Korun]]. However, the planet instead decided to escape any persecution by joining hands with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

The Judiciary was later involved in questioning rogue [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] saboteur [[Gavrilonnis Tejere]] before he could complete his work on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After being processed, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] revealed to the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] that Tejere had no connection to the Separatists. Judicial Forces did not reveal their questioning of the suspect after he was brought into custody by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Yoda and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. The investigation of the Givin saboteur was later a joint venture between the Judiciary and [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] agents as well as overseen by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Qu Rahn/Legends|Qu Rahn]].<ref name="HNN53153">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 53|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #53]]</ref> At another point, the Department was involved in a joint investigation with the Jedi Order over the possibility of [[Stone mite]]s being a genetically engineered weapon deployed on worlds after the planet [[Ord Tiddell/Legends|Ord Tiddell]] suffered from a devastation infestation of the insects.<ref name="HNN53155" />

They along with the Jedi Order also worked in concert to battle the threat of the [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|Pirates of Iridium]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]]. In the resultant [[Skirmish over Vuchelle|skirmish]], four Republic Judiciaries along with two Jedi Knights were killed over the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Vuchelle]]. This was later revealed to the news network by the Judicial Department, which highlighted the victory over the pirate forces of [[Iridium]].<ref name="HNN53149">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #49]]</ref> The department also denied the attempts by the [[People's Inquest]] to reveal the budget of the Jedi Order.<ref name="HNN53148" /> With the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Judicial Department was dissolved, and its responsibilities were given to other agencies.<ref name="Dissolved" />
